notes: All 72 accepted analysis artifacts reviewed against their hashes and preserved.
Nine existing baseline text artifacts are supporting MUST COMMIT dependencies; they are not modified.
MAY COMMIT contains plots without source photographs. Qualitative source-image montages remain ignored under the raw redistribution/disposable-image policy.
Root .gitignore already ignores checkpoints/training images/logs/raw snapshots. New outputs/.gitignore covers the explicitly listed replay/intermediate and machine-specific development files.
No tests require a new model forward or access to real test data. Optional/ignored artifact links in the accepted report remain local-only.
